method: Read-only review of the full runtime diff and relevant call sites after implementation, following review-agent instructions. Performed by the implementation agent, not an independent reviewer. Implementation fixes were made outside that review.
resolvedFindings: Reproduce V19 RATE_LIMIT on legitimate delayed WebRTC state packets, coalesce excess snapshots while retaining the latest world and bounded packet validation.
Reset control flood strikes each window; clear pending snapshot timers on departure.
Separate channel negotiation from the lobby handshake deadline after two repeatable full-game rejoin timeouts; keep finite negotiation, handshake and overall limits.
Open the tyre sidewalls and rim barrel so actual disc glow is visible between spokes; raycast every stock vehicle wheel.
Preserve hoses and fluid through tyre repair, upgrades and save/load; refill does not seal leaks and hose replacement does not refill.
limits: Fictional diagonal hydraulic layout on all four cars; lumped pressure and separated fluid supplies. No pedal-travel, fluid-boiling, master-cylinder, booster or ABS-valve faults. Existing shared pad/disc condition retained.
Disc glow is temperature-driven emission, without additional lights. Closed dish rims occlude discs; remote cars do not receive detailed component temperatures.
Actual public signaling/WebRTC tested between local browser processes/contexts. No separate physical-PC, mobile network, restrictive NAT or TURN traversal test.
Software renderer, no subjective listening or physical controller test. CPU measurement excludes world/GPU/AI/audio and does not establish an FPS guarantee.
visualCheck: Final garage, brake condition and driving screenshots inspected after the final build. Existing cartoon style retained.
Full-game multiplayer renders the remote vehicle; the original map-label density remains outside this change.
